rules.swrl: FishingVessel(?v) ^ hasState(?v, ?s) ^ LoiteringState(?s) ^ locatedIn(?v, ?a) ^ SensitiveArea(?a) -> hasPotentialIllegalActivity(?v, ?a)
rules.condition: LoiteringState(s) and locatedIn(v, a) and SensitiveArea(a)

rules.swrlPattern: hasPotentialIllegalActivity(?v, ?a) ^ hasState(?v, ?s) ^ durationSeconds(?s, ?d) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?d, 600) ^ travelDistance(?s, ?m) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?m, 0.5)
rules.plannerAction: materialize SuspectedIllegalFishingActivity using a deterministic event ID
